_comment: Fully-CONVOLUTIONAL recurrent ViT (2D conv Q/K/V, channel-inner-product spatial-softmax attention, ConvLSTM memory, conv actor/critic) on a C×10×10 grid. SAME harness as the paper build (RL + buffer constant): PAC + QR-DQN + PER + EMA targets, 5 particles, gamma 0.95. Checkpoints live OUTSIDE the Drive-synced repo.

environment._note: paper 7-step task; change fixed at t=5,6; sigma=5; k starts 65

model._note: fully-conv net: stem 50->10 (C=64); conv Q/K/V over [X||H]; aligned channel inner product -> spatial softmax -> broadcast V; ConvLSTM memory; conv actor/critic. n_quantiles = particles.

ppo._note: 150,000 episodes = 18,750 iters x 8 episodes/iter. EMA target (ema_decay>0) REPLACES the hard-copy (target_update_period=0). RL + buffer settings identical to the paper build.
